summary: Minimal backend check of Pix readiness fix (3 checks, no LLM/payments). All passed. Admin GET /api/admin/pix/readiness -> 200, configured=false, configuration.api_key_hint is a string. Unauth and invalid token -> 401. Offline pytest test_pix_readiness.py: 30 passed.

The hint works correctly and does not leak the secret.
